title: The Uniswap Swap

captures.note: dry — reached the swap confirm; wallet connect click failed silently, portfolio legs missing

_comment: Trace: wallets/uniswap-swap-trace.md, from Uniswap/interface web/5.157.3 + dig/curl of every host (Aug 24 2026). The novel thing vs a plain send: the ROUTE + Universal Router execute() CALLDATA the user signs come from a closed Trading API (/quote then /swap). ETH->USDC on a plain MetaMask EOA falls back to CLASSIC Universal Router (native-ETH UniswapX needs EIP-7914 + a smart wallet) so no /order, no ERC-20 approval, no Permit2 sig. These dapp steps prepend; MetaMask's own backbone (m1: nonce, gas, tx-sentinel, Blockaid, STX broadcast, receipt) then wraps and signs the calldata. Permit2 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3 applies only to ERC-20 inputs. Capture 20260824-095240: trading API served from entry-gateway.backend-prod.api.uniswap.org (not interface.gateway); a compliancev2Service (FeatureGatedTokens/GatedFeatures) runs on it — candidate step, not yet authored. Dry run stopped before /check_approval and /swap fired.

prepend_steps.name: Trading API /quote — route + minOut
prepend_steps.purpose: Compute the route (v2/v3/v4), amountOut, minOut, price impact, gas; server-side simulation
prepend_steps.returns: the route + quoted output the user believes and approves

worst_lie.note: a bad route or a low minOut is carried into the /swap calldata → sandwich / drain within tolerance; a false quote is a false belief about output

prepend_steps.notes: CORE BLACK BOX. A faster indicative /quote (routingPreference FASTEST) fires first for instant UI; the primary quote is BEST_PRICE. For a native-ETH EOA on mainnet the response is CLASSIC (Universal Router), not UniswapX. If the pool route needs a Permit2 sig the response embeds the EIP-712 message here. · code-traced base URL was interface.gateway.uniswap.org/v1/quote; live traffic Aug 24 2026 goes to entry-gateway.backend-prod.api.uniswap.org

prepend_steps.name: Trading API /check_approval
prepend_steps.purpose: Does the input token need an ERC-20 approval / Permit2?

worst_lie.note: for ERC-20 inputs this returns the approval/Permit2 target the user signs; a bad spender is an unlimited allowance to an attacker

prepend_steps.notes: For ETH→USDC the input is native ETH → returns NONE (no approval, no Permit2 sig, no on-chain approve tx). Permit2 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3 + a signed EIP-712 permit only appear when the input is an ERC-20.

prepend_steps.name: Trading API /swap — the calldata you sign
prepend_steps.purpose: Build the Universal Router execute() calldata + value from the chosen quote
prepend_steps.returns: the unsigned tx (to=Universal Router, value=ETH, data=execute() bytes) the wallet signs

worst_lie.note: the user signs calldata a closed API produced; Universal Router commands are custom-encoded, not plain ABI, so the wallet cannot say locally what it does. A malicious execute() drains within the signed value

prepend_steps.notes: THE SIGNATURE OBJECT. to = Universal Router (from getChainInfo, URv2.x); an optional Uniswap interface fee is baked into the bytes. From here the inherited MetaMask backbone (nonce, gas oracle, tx-sentinel simulation, Blockaid verdict, sign, STX broadcast, receipt) wraps and signs THIS calldata — its simulation/Blockaid now see the router call, not a plain send.
